sceneConcept: A solid forty-eight-year-old Chinese bank branch manager stands alone against a transparent background. Short black hair greys neatly at the temples; rectangular glasses, tired eye lines and a restrained gaze suggest he is containing concern. He wears a conservative dark-navy business suit, crisp white dress shirt, muted burgundy tie, polished black shoes and a plain wristwatch. His fingers interlock formally at his waist while he offers a small professional smile that does not reach the eyes. Soft even frontal studio light presents an ordinary experienced manager rather than a conspirator.
